title: Orc vs Uruk-hai
script: This is an Orc. This is an Uruk-hai. So what's the difference? Most people think they're just the same ugly monsters serving dark lords. They're not. Orcs are smaller, corrupted creatures who are severely weakened by daylight and lack discipline. Uruk-hai are Saruman's engineered super-hybrids built with human size, full sunlight immunity, and devastating physical power. That's why Orcs hide in dark caves, while Uruk-hai march directly into battle. Follow for more.
